MAINLINE-015b. Continuous SF 1 stays kd 0.5183040769. Not rescored.

The filed RMS paired a lambda 1 amplitude with a lambda 2.625 width and used nu 0.30. The live map carries nu 0.33 only. Amplitude and width are both lambda_I = 1. The filed RMS is 2.611 times the live RMS. kd 0.9 is below delta/t 0.07. P2-E R/t 50.75 is outside the fit.

Lee 2016 Eq. 23 is kd = 0.068 + 0.25/(0.28+delta/t), the lower envelope over k = 1 to 5 at R/t 100 and 200. No FEM result is below delta/t 0.15 and no ODE result below 0.2. No shell here is at those radii. RMS at k = 5 is five times RMS at k = 1.
